text: You set up your fucking Comment GUIDE flow, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Bro, I woke up to four hundred comments. ManyChat sent four hundred guides.
style: Proud and hyped, bragging over breakfast to his buddy, a casual American guy.
Flat and deadpan, a trap question.
Deflated, a beat of silence before 'Zero', then frustrated.

text: ManyChat did its job, the guide went out. Then they replied, read me one.
style: Calm and sly, like a detective, a short beat before 'read me one'.

text: Is this guide for beginners? And my flow sent him the guide, again.
style: First reading the message out loud from his phone, then embarrassed and annoyed on 'again'.

text: It answers the keyword, not the question. Bro, you built a vending machine.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last words.

text: And the people who asked something else?
style: Worried, almost afraid of the answer.

text: Left on read, collecting dust like the juicer you bought in January.
style: Teasing and mocking, a beat before 'like the juicer', the last word savored.

text: So I rebuild the whole flow, at midnight?
style: Stressed and tired, voice going up at the end.

text: Nope. Keep your ManyChat, add me. Two actions in your flow, no code.
style: Smooth and confident, a sly little offer, easy and relaxed.

text: And you'd answer the beginner guy?
I answer his real question, in your voice. Only the serious ones get your calendar.
style: Calm and confident, a hint of smugness, a short beat between the two sentences.

text: Okay, how do I add you?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Drink your lawn first, it's turning brown.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift. Say the name SETTY clearly as SET-tee, two syllables ending on a long ee, with a tiny pause after it.
